reason: I've never paid for a sleep app and YouTube with a 30-minute timer already does the job for free. I might grab the free 14-day trial since there's no auto-charge, but I don't see myself paying 4,900원 a month after it.
objection: It says the records stay on my phone, which is good, but my real problem is waking up at 3-4am, and I'm not convinced a fade-out timer fixes that enough to be worth paying for when free stuff exists.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day comparison clearly showed I got back to sleep a lot faster after the 3-4am wake-ups, I'd consider the 39,000원 yearly plan.
